notes: FROZEN, daemon=incapable: DeepSeek Harness emits transient assistant chunks only through the process-local agent/assistant-stream event. The durable session.v3.jsonl.zstd log receives one complete assistant/message with the compact stream after settlement, followed by turn/end. The DSH adapter tails only that durable log, so no live partial-flush window reaches irrlichd. A lifecycle-only working dwell would pass over transcript silence and duplicate basic-turn, so this meta-only spec asserts no phases.
